name: agent-bev Library
description: The trade rulebook for beverage alcohol, country by country, each section with its official sources. Read-only, session-free.

skills.name: get_rulebook
skills.description: The trade rulebook for one country by its two-letter code (uk for the United Kingdom): market status, who can trade, customs and duty, labelling, age and sale limits, protected names, GTIN authority, and open items and as-of date; each section lists its official sources, and a part with no official source says "Not yet sourced".

skills.name: list_countries
skills.description: Every country in the Library with its code, its page and its as-of date.

notice: Artificial intelligence makes mistakes. agent-bev is an information source, not a recommendation.

payment.reads: free today: every read of the Library answers without payment
payment.when_priced: a priced resource answers HTTP 402 with the x402 offer; the agent pays in any listed currency and the read is served
